clsRegressionFoundAndFixed.symptom: CLS 0.132 on the Palace on Wheels page, reproducible to three decimals across runs, against a previous 0
clsRegressionFoundAndFixed.misdiagnosis: First assumed font-metric mismatch on the display face, then font-display swap on it. Adding metric-matched fallbacks and switching the display face to optional changed the number by exactly nothing — which was the clue that the diagnosis was wrong
clsRegressionFoundAndFixed.actualCause: Lighthouse named it outright in the audit sub-items: inter-600-latin.woff2. Semibold carries the hero eyebrow, badges, route strip and buttons; when it swapped in, the hero content reflowed, and because that content is bottom-aligned the whole block moved
clsRegressionFoundAndFixed.whyNotReproducedLocally: A CDP harness with a reused profile had the font cached, so it recorded zero shifts even under CPU and network throttling. Cold-cache behaviour was the whole bug
clsRegressionFoundAndFixed.fix: Inter 600 preloaded AND set to font-display: optional, the same pairing already used for the display face. Preloaded it wins the ~100ms window in almost every real case; when it does not, the page stays still and the metric-matched fallback stands in
clsRegressionFoundAndFixed.result: CLS 0 on all four pages, and FCP on journey pages improved from 1.1s to 0.9s
